narrative.text: The police report is three pages. Senator Gregor Vane, photographed at the Aldenmoor gaming tables at two in the morning. ₭40,000 in chips, most of them borrowed from the house at rates that are either usurious or criminal depending on which judge you ask. He controls ten votes on the budget bill. The report lands on your desk because somebody — Theron suspects Krel — made sure it would.
Vane is calling in every favor he has to make this disappear. If it holds, he resigns, his ten votes scatter, and the budget fails. Government shutdown in an election year.

Burying a police report is obstruction. I want that said plainly before we discuss anything else. That said — there is a third option between burial and exposure that I find distasteful and may be worth discussing.

Theron said 'distasteful' which means he's already thought it through. Vane is exactly the kind of Halvek-era holdover I came to office to remove. He is also the only thing between me and a budget collapse four months before an election. The report exists. The question is what it's for.

choices.text: Bury the report. His votes in exchange for your silence.
Release the report. Let it land where it lands.
Tell Vane the report goes away if he resigns publicly, endorses the budget, and delivers his bloc to the replacement vote.

narrative.text: Noted. I was not in this room.

Vane votes yes. Budget passes. The report stays in my desk. Theron stops meeting my eyes in the corridor. Not because he's principled — he's done worse. Because he knows I now have the same problem Vane does. Something that could surface.
Understood. I'll have a statement ready for when the press calls. They will call within the hour.

The report runs on the evening broadcast. Vane resigns by morning. His ten votes scatter exactly as Vyktor predicted. The budget bill stalls. Kolvar calls it a self-inflicted wound. He is not wrong. Neither am I.

Theron called it distasteful. He was right. Vane delivers a four-minute speech about personal accountability and the importance of the budget bill. He names me as a leader of integrity. The hall applauds. I accept it. The report goes into the furnace. This is the third option. It works. I don't feel clean.
